scope: Chapters aggregate their indexed publications; subchapters use publications indexed in that subchapter.
crossReferences: A cross-reference does not transfer a trial grade to another diagnosis, a methods discussion or a research hypothesis.

thresholds.1: At least three distinct peer-reviewed study units
thresholds.2: At least three distinct eligible randomized controlled trial units
thresholds.3: At least three distinct eligible double-blind randomized controlled trial units

exclusions: Guidelines, conference abstracts, unpublished material and unresolved sources do not acquire a peer-reviewed study rating.
